title: retire(components): remove the second ActionParamDialog export; app-shell's is the surviving implementation (#5685)
body:
Fixes #5685

## What this is

Maintainer ruling of 2026-08-22 on the issue (option A, recorded by the triage seat): **retire** `@object-ui/components`' `ActionParamDialog` — the repo's second implementation of the action-param surface. The app-shell dialog (`packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx`) is the surviving implementation and is untouched by this PR. The five-string i18n rebind the card originally asked for dies with the retirement, per the same ruling — it is deliberately not done here.

## Policy measurement — why this is one PR, not deprecate-then-remove

The ruling says "deprecate-first per repo policy"; the dispatch instructed measuring what that policy resolves to rather than inventing it. Measured:

- **No written deprecation policy exists**: zero hits for "deprecat" as policy in `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`; `docs/` hits are audits.
- **The practiced policy for zero-consumer published surfaces is direct removal in one PR**, `minor` bump, breaking semantics + migration terms in the changeset, surviving implementation named. Instances in this repo's own history: the #4328 dead-surface sweep (`@object-ui/core` stopped exporting `mergeViewsIntoObjects` with "The live implementation … is unchanged and remains the only one"), the zero-consumer `@object-ui/tenant` package dropped whole (#2564), the phantom `CloudOperations` surface (#4152), the shadowed `SimpleTableRenderer` deleted (#5125), `capability-multiselect` (#3308), the `global_nav` designer surfaces (#4169).
- **Deprecation windows appear only where a survey found real consumers** (the objectstack#7917 ruling: "the runtime lift retires behind a deprecation window sized by a stored-dashboard survey", Phase 2 scheduled separately), and `@deprecated`-and-keep is used for surfaces that still have importers (the legacy `ActionSchema` in `crud.ts`).

This export is in the first class, so the standing precedent applies: direct removal, one PR, no follow-up card.

## Zero-consumer premise, re-measured on the base (`origin/main` @ 286dd8daa)

- In-repo importers of the components copy: exactly its own five `__tests__/action-param-dialog-*.test.tsx` files plus the `custom` barrel line. All other ~38 in-repo `ActionParamDialog` hits are the app-shell twin or comments about it (verified file-by-file).
- `packages/components/src/custom/config-panel-renderer.tsx` mentions it only in a comment (confirmed).
- Sibling repo `objectstack`: all 5 mentions are comments about the app-shell/console dialog; zero imports of `@object-ui/components` anywhere in that repo.
- GitHub org-wide code search for the symbol outside objectui: 9 hits, all in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, all comments/changelogs — no importer.
- ADR check: `docs/adr/0059` names the **app-shell** `ActionParamDialog` as its consumer, which survives — no ADR change is required, so the governed surface stays untouched.

## Changes

- Delete `packages/components/src/custom/action-param-dialog.tsx` and its five test files.
- Drop `export * from './action-param-dialog';` from `packages/components/src/custom/index.ts`.
- Changeset (`.changeset/retire-components-action-param-dialog-5685.md`): `@object-ui/components` **minor** per the version-alignment rule (never `major`), with breaking semantics and FROM → TO migration terms for an out-of-repo host. Note the surviving twin is **not** a published standalone export — it is rendered by app-shell's action runtime — so the migration text says so honestly instead of promising a drop-in.
- Two named in-scope companions of the retirement (both are debris of the retired surface, declared here for review):
  - **Withdraw the unreleased #4758 changeset** (`.changeset/action-param-dialog-option-visiblewhen-4758.md`): it documents a `select`-options fix to this very component; the component retires before that fix ever ships, so keeping it would put behaviour notes for a nonexistent surface into the same release's notes.
  - **Unlist the deleted file** from `config-panel-renderer.tsx`'s "measured, not chosen" `createSafeTranslation` site list (comment-only edit) — otherwise the comment names a file that no longer exists.

## Verification (all at head `6d9c8321c`; the tree tested is byte-identical to the commit — `git status --porcelain` was empty between the runs and the commit, and nothing was edited after)

- Build, components + full dependency closure (8 turbo tasks): `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`, 48.5s.
- **Published-surface proof from the freshly built dist**: `grep -c ActionParamDialog packages/components/dist/index.d.ts` → `0`; no file under `packages/components/dist/` contains the symbol. The worktree never had a pre-edit build, so this cannot be a stale-dist reading.
- Type-check (`turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/components`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Tests, whole package from the repo root (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/ --maxWorkers=2`): **`Test Files 179 passed (179)` / `Tests 1640 passed (1640)`**, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Gates re-run at `6d9c8321c`, each quoting its own verdict line: changeset presence ("✅ 8 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), no-major ("✅ No changeset declares a `major` bump."), control-bytes ("✅ check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 4807 tracked text file(s))"), self-import ("✅ No package names itself inside its own src/.").
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report, exit 0): the deleted file's only key, `common.select`, keeps its other consumers (`LookupField`, pinned pack tests) — no orphaned key.
- ESLint on the two surviving edited files: 0 errors (3 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings in `config-panel-renderer.tsx`, untouched by this diff).

**Declared narrowing** (CI runs the full farm): the repo-wide build/lint/test farm was not run locally. Evidence the narrowing excludes nothing: (1) a removed export can only break a module that names the symbol, and the population of symbol references was measured over the whole workspace plus the org (zero importers outside the deleted files); (2) this repo's lint rules are per-file AST bans (no cross-file count baselines — verified in `eslint.config.js` / `eslint-rules/`), so untouched files' verdicts cannot move; (3) `check-eager-closure-budget` is a size **ceiling** on the console's eager closure — a pure removal cannot raise it.

Not touched: `content/` (so the real `Build Docs` does not trigger; the known-red #5668 stays out of play), `docs/adr/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, and everything under `packages/app-shell/`.
